summary: Ecopetrol S.A. filed a Form 6-K announcing senior management changes approved by its Board on August 27, 2026. Five vice presidents and one director in areas including HSE, administration, communications, strategy, and refining will depart effective August 30, 2026, with internal acting replacements assumed the next day. The departures appear abrupt and simultaneous, suggesting a forced or coordinated management overhaul rather than routine succession. Permanent appointments will be announced later. The company expressed gratitude, but no reasons for departures were provided. Watch for further executive turnover or strategic redirection.
